categories.main_business_segments: IAT Automobile Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in complete vehicle and vehicle platform R&D, new energy intelligent platform development, and core automotive component R&D and manufacturing. The company offers full-process vehicle design services including product definition, styling, engineering, software development, performance development, prototype manufacturing, and testing. It also produces core components such as powertrain parts, high-voltage electrical systems for new energy vehicles, and automotive electronics. The company is the only independent automotive design firm listed on the A-share market in China.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced automotive design technologies including AI-driven digital design platforms, AUTOSAR-compliant software architectures, and modular physical platforms covering passenger and commercial vehicles. It develops integrated powertrain systems such as four-in-one electric drive assemblies, electromagnetic dedicated hybrid transmissions (DHT), and V6 engines with advanced combustion and emission control technologies. AI large models are applied in styling, CAD generation, simulation, and project management to enhance R&D efficiency. The company also focuses on software-defined vehicle (SDV) architectures and intelligent chassis platforms with line-controlled chassis and four-wheel independent steering.
categories.primary_customers_markets: IAT serves over 80 domestic and international automotive clients including major OEMs such as Honda, Nissan, Toyota, FAW, Dongfeng, BAIC, JMC, and emerging new energy vehicle companies. Its products and services cover multiple vehicle segments from A0 to C class passenger cars, SUVs, MPVs, vans, pickups, and commercial vehicles including intelligent buses and autonomous shuttles. The company is expanding its footprint in overseas markets, especially Japan, Southeast Asia, Europe, Middle East, and the Americas, targeting new energy vehicle development and core component supply.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and multiple R&D centers in Beijing, Shanghai, and other cities. It has established subsidiaries and branches in Japan, the United States, Germany, Malaysia, and other countries to support its global 'technology + supply chain' export strategy. Overseas operations include vehicle design, component manufacturing, and export activities, with a growing presence in Japan and emerging markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: IAT operates mainly in the upstream segment of the automotive supply chain, focusing on vehicle and component R&D and design services. It extends into midstream manufacturing of core automotive components such as powertrains and high-voltage electrical systems. The company also integrates downstream activities through vehicle prototype manufacturing, small batch production, and export of complete vehicles and components, forming a vertically integrated service and supply chain ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include advancing AI-enabled automotive R&D, expanding the 'technology + supply chain' global export strategy, and accelerating digital and intelligent transformation. It invests heavily in AI large models for styling, engineering, simulation, and project management to build an AI-native vehicle design automation platform (VDA). R&D focuses on intelligent chassis, software-defined vehicles, autonomous driving (L2-L4), integrated powertrain systems, and cross-domain heterogeneous vehicle operating systems. The company also emphasizes internationalization and collaboration with global partners to enhance innovation and market reach.
categories.revenue_model: IAT generates revenue primarily through project-based vehicle design and engineering services, including commissioned design and technical support contracts. It also earns income from manufacturing and selling core automotive components, technology licensing, and technical consulting. The company provides modular and turnkey solutions, with revenue recognized upon contract milestones or service delivery. Increasingly, it offers subscription-based AI design tools and integrated service packages to global clients.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: IAT is positioned as a leading independent automotive design and R&D service provider in China, uniquely listed on the A-share market. It competes with domestic and international automotive design firms and OEM in-house R&D teams, especially in high-value new energy vehicle and intelligent vehicle segments. The company leverages its comprehensive full-stack vehicle development capabilities, AI innovation, and globalized service network to differentiate itself. It maintains strong partnerships with major Japanese OEMs and is expanding into emerging overseas markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, IAT reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 971 million, a 13.17% increase year-over-year, with net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB -132.8 million due to industry price pressures and high R&D investment. The company’s total assets were about RMB 3.28 billion with equity of RMB 2.29 billion. It has a workforce of over 2,300 employees, with 82.5% in R&D roles. The company is in a growth phase, focusing on expanding overseas revenue (which grew 188.9% to RMB 110.6 million) and commercializing AI-enabled automotive design tools.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: IAT emphasizes its unique dual-wheel business model combining full-process vehicle design and core component manufacturing, supported by over 1,900 patents and extensive industry experience. Its AI-driven vehicle design automation platform and modular physical platforms enable rapid, flexible, and cost-effective vehicle development. The company’s globalized R&D network and deep integration with supply chain partners allow it to deliver high-quality, customized solutions for new energy and intelligent vehicles. Its pioneering electromagnetic DHT and integrated powertrain systems offer performance and efficiency advantages, positioning IAT as a trusted technology innovator in the automotive industry.
